archetypes.name: cleanup-safety
archetypes.rationale: Review cleanup logic must preserve user carryover while removing only coder residue.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the snapshot-mode cleanup paths in python/review_and_fix.py. Check that full snapshots and head-only snapshots restore the right baselines after failed coder, submodule, and commit attempts. Look for cases where pre-existing staged, unstaged, or untracked user work could be removed or accidentally staged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: waterfall-contract
archetypes.rationale: The external-coder waterfall has changed status and retry behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review apply_findings_with_coder and its tests as an integration contract. Verify Cursor then Codex ordering, rc/status mapping, no-changes classification, submodule terminal behavior, and commit-failure fallback. Pay special attention to result_file KVs and branch prose consistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
